sources.excerpt: Fuzzrocious Introduces the Egg Sack Pedal – No Treble Skip to main content No Treble Gear Basses Amps Pedals & Effects Accessories & Strings Pickups Bass of the Week Gear Reviews News New Albums Sheet Music & Instruction Concerts & Tours Events Columns From the Bottom Bass Players To Know Ask Damian Erskine Recording Bass The Lightbulb Moment The Lowdown with Dr. D Health & Fitness Lessons Keep It Groovy Bass Gym Talking Technique Bass Transcriptions The Brown’stone Creative Bass Lines Bass & Creativity Bass Lick Series Advanced Bass Talking Style Bassists Interviews Wonder Women Stories Behind the Songs Reader Spotlight In Memoriam Share Your Story Videos Podcast Bass Nerds Podcast Groove Podcast Shop Subscribe Archives On This Day in Bass Contributors Contact Home Bass Gear Pedals & Effects Fuzzrocious Introduces the Egg Sack Pedal by Kevin Johnson Saturday, November 2nd, 2019 Share Tweet Email Comments Fuzzrocious Pedals has introduced a new pedal to their lineup called the Egg Sack. The unit features the boost, drive, and distortion portion of their Playing Mantis that was introduced earlier this year. It has a volume know and simple three-position switch for setting your effect. “All three settings have tons of volume on tap to allow you to reach the volume you need and exceed it if need be,” Fuzzrocious writes. “Sound better in a mix, push your amp/cab, piss off your pets, or make the audience squeal with joy. Egg Sack has it all.” Hear the Egg Sack on bass starting at the 2:18 mark in this demo: The Fuzzrocious Pedals Egg Sack is limited to 50 units. It’s available now for $99.99. Fuzzrocious Pedals Egg Sack Pedal Features: Three Settings: Distortion, Boost, Drive Volume Knob No baby praying mantises were harmed in the making of these pedals. 9VDC Power In his time with No Treble, Kevin has met hundreds of amazing bassists and interviewed icons like Jack Casady, Victor Wooten, Les Claypool, Marcus Miller, and more. He's a gigging bassist performing jazz in Northern Virginia and bluegrass with The Plate Scrapers up and down the East Coast. Kevin appreciates all genres of music, from R&B to metal and everything in between. Connect with Kevin on Facebook and check his performance schedule on his website .
